what_this_is: Rendering vectors for the topic consumer contract in spec/consumer-v1.md. A conforming client renders each case's `build` to exactly its `script` with exactly its `parameters`, and refuses each case carrying `refused` before sending.
this_is_language_not_protocol: Section 6 of protocol-v1.md puts the query language outside the protocol. This corpus sits beside the query corpus for the same reason.
run_it_against_a_node_too: Rendering agreement is the offline half. Section 7 of the contract is the other: each client runs its consumer against a node built from the engine's dev branch.

cases.name: read-a-batch
cases.script: USE NAMESPACE shop; USE DATABASE live; READ FROM orders FOR CONSUMER 'mailer' LIMIT 10;

cases.name: read-one-at-a-time
cases.script: USE NAMESPACE shop; USE DATABASE live; READ FROM orders FOR CONSUMER 'mailer' LIMIT 1;

cases.name: a-group-name-may-carry-dots-colons-and-dashes
cases.note: The group is a string literal, so §3 allows more than an identifier does.
cases.script: USE NAMESPACE shop; USE DATABASE live; READ FROM orders FOR CONSUMER 'billing.v2:eu-west' LIMIT 10;

cases.name: acknowledge-one-position
cases.script: USE NAMESPACE shop; USE DATABASE live; ACK orders FOR CONSUMER 'mailer' AT $p0;

cases.name: acknowledge-several-positions-in-the-order-given
cases.note: Positions are bound, never written into the text, and named from p0.
cases.script: USE NAMESPACE shop; USE DATABASE live; ACK orders FOR CONSUMER 'mailer' AT $p0, $p1, $p2;

cases.name: hand-back-at-once
cases.script: USE NAMESPACE shop; USE DATABASE live; NACK orders FOR CONSUMER 'mailer' AT $p0;

cases.name: hand-back-with-no-delay-writes-no-delay-clause
cases.note: A delay of nothing is no clause at all, not DELAY 0ms.
cases.script: USE NAMESPACE shop; USE DATABASE live; NACK orders FOR CONSUMER 'mailer' AT $p0;

cases.name: hand-back-after-a-delay
cases.note: The delay is a duration literal the client formats from a number, in milliseconds.
cases.script: USE NAMESPACE shop; USE DATABASE live; NACK orders FOR CONSUMER 'mailer' AT $p0, $p1 DELAY 1500ms;

cases.name: a-group-carrying-a-quote-is-refused-not-escaped
cases.note: Refusing is the defence (§3); an escaped quote would be a client deciding what the node's lexer does.
